scenes: How many air conditioners will Southeast Asia need?
About forty million today could become three hundred million by 2040. | Half of them could be in Indonesia.
Every one adds to peak power demand, | and pushes waste heat into the street.
Cooler buildings shrink the need: | shade, reflective roofs, and efficient machines.
The coolest kilowatt is the one you never need.
